description: The remaining error bodies the chain reacts to, keyed by scenario.

needsPaid.description: HTTP 403 code 5035 — the model needs a Workers Paid plan. Account-level, so the chain stops.

accountBlocked.description: HTTP 403 code 3023 — the account is blocked. Account-level, so the chain stops.

tooLarge.description: HTTP 413 code 3006 — the prompt is too large. The student is told to start a new chat.

badModelId.description: HTTP 404 code 3042 — the model id does not exist. Only that model's remaining attempts are skipped.

unparseable429.description: HTTP 429 with a body carrying no code at all — treated as capacity, so the chain moves on.
